    Rescaling free linear path realizations #

    Rescaling each arrow representative multiplies the realization of a path by the product of its arrow scalars. This is the algebraic content of the final contour-function correction in multiplicative-basis standardness proofs.

    source
    def LargeIndecomposable.LinearPathCategory.rescaleArrow {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] {C : Type z} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, z} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (F₀ : Q → C) (F₁ : {i j : Q} → (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i)) (s : {i j : Q} → (i ⟶ j) → k) {i j : Q} (a : i ⟶ j) :
    F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i

    Multiply every reversed arrow representative by its assigned scalar.

      theorem LargeIndecomposable.LinearPathCategory.pathMap_rescaleArrow {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] {C : Type z} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, z} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (F₀ : Q → C) (F₁ : {i j : Q} → (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i)) (s : {i j : Q} → (i ⟶ j) → k) {i j : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
      pathMap F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => rescaleArrow F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => F₁) fun {i j : Q} => s) p = Quiver.Path.weight (fun {i j : Q} => s) p • pathMap F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => F₁) p

      A path evaluated with rescaled arrows is its original value multiplied by the product of the arrow scalars along that path.

      theorem LargeIndecomposable.LinearPathCategory.lift_rescaleArrow_map_pathHom {k : Type u} [Field k] {Q : Type v} [Quiver Q] {C : Type z} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_1, z} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (F₀ : Q → C) (F₁ : {i j : Q} → (i ⟶ j) → (F₀ j ⟶ F₀ i)) (s : {i j : Q} → (i ⟶ j) → k) {i j : Q} (p : Quiver.Path i j) :
      (lift F₀ fun {i j : Q} => rescaleArrow F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => F₁) fun {i j : Q} => s).map (pathHom p) = Quiver.Path.weight (fun {i j : Q} => s) p • (lift F₀ fun {i j : Q} => F₁).map (pathHom p)

      The corresponding free linear functors satisfy the same formula on every path-basis morphism.

      pathMap F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => rescaleArrow F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => F₁) fun {i j : Q} => s) p = pathMap F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => rescaleArrow F₀ (fun {i j : Q} => F₁) fun {i j : Q} => s) q

      A scalar contour discrepancy disappears after arrow rescaling whenever the two path weights satisfy the displayed coboundary equation.
